description: Fork of exp071 widening v_lut: d_v 16->32, v_tph 256->512, v_input_nap 7->6. Also flattens out_proj tph schedule to 2048 everywhere. E=96 unchanged. H*d_v becomes 192 (out_proj input doubles). Per-layer LUT: qk 6.29M (same), v 6*512*64*32=6.29M (was 3.15M, 2x), out 12.58M (all layers, was 12.58/6.29 mix). Total ~173M. Pair coverage: qk 33.7% (same), v 67.4% (was 39.3%), out_proj 67.0% (was saturated 269/134).
